items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: he thought Teschmacher was so great that there was no comparison of course with anybody

ctx.x: the one who said that Bix died of everything which I think was a very good way of putting it when they asked when they were trying to figure out how he died and he said he died of everything

he could think up things that you know like other people on the way home they said I wish I'd said that but he always had everything ready very sharp tongue too in some ways it made a few people mad at times he's always trying to ride Mez in the late years he evidently didn't get along too well with him so he was always trying to belittle him but anyway to get back to Panassier Mez of course was one of his big favorites after Jimmy Noon I think he thought Mez was about the greatest clarinetist that had ever lived…
I thought Panassier liked Louis especially I'm not wrong
